question: In the direct recycling of lithium-ion battery electrodes by solvent recovery with ethylene glycol, how much capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retain after its 1000 cycles?
rendered:
The 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell retained 65.7% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles. 

This information is found in the excerpt from the paper "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials" on page 2.
